links.outcome: Readability of LLM answers to ROP patient questions (FRE, FKGL, Coleman-Liau)
links.effect: Gemini had the best readability, with an FRE score of 39.1 (difficult text). ChatGPT-4 was the most accurate and reliable (DISCERN 63, EQIP 72.2) but its texts were more complex.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4 excelled in providing detailed and reliable responses to ROP-related queries, although its texts were more complex.

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLMs (ChatGPT-4, BingAI, Gemini) answering retrospective patient inquiries about retinopathy of prematurity, assessed by ophthalmologists using standard scales (DISCERN, EQIP, readability), without evaluating a specific operational deployment safeguard or practice.
